title: Why Classical Optimization Struggles to Keep Pace With Manufacturing
summary: Manufacturing optimization complexity is pushing the limits of classical optimization tools. Learn how hybrid quantum optimization could improve decision-making
body_markdown:
Manufacturing optimization challenges are growing in operational complexity, and traditional optimization tools can struggle to manage this complexity effectively. Hybrid quantum optimization offers a new approach to improve scheduling, resource allocation, and real-time decision-making.


**Where classical optimization solutions struggle:** Modern manufacturing often involves highly interdependent variables that change in real time. The scale of variables and speed at which decisions are required are pushing the limits of legacy optimization tools, which can lead to missed efficiency gains, increased costs and constant operational troubleshooting.


**How quantum optimization can improve manufacturing decision-making:** Hybrid-quantum optimization solutions, which leverage quantum and classical computing together, can evaluate far more variables, constraints, and interdependencies than classical-only solutions, often enabling faster and higher-quality solutions.


To explore this growing trend, D-Wave partnered with[Manufacturing Dive](https://www.manufacturingdive.com/) to publish a playbook on how manufacturers are starting to apply quantum optimization to their hard operational challenges.[Download the playbook to get started](https://www.dwavequantum.com/learn/resource-library/manufacturing-dive-playbook/) .
